component.name: ActOne Screenplay
component.summary: Modern screenplay and script writing application

description.p: ActOne Screenplay is a native plain-text Fountain screenplay editor for Windows and Linux. Featuring live syntax formatting, outline tree navigation, X-Ray analytics, automatic revision snapshots, and local Muse AI assistant.
ActOne supports standard Fountain markup, index cards, customizable visual themes, ambient focus soundscapes, and production-ready PDF, FDX, and Fade In exports.
